notes.title: 2022 Patch 2: The Big One
notes.notes:
It's the Big One!

Game updates:
[list]
[*]PlayStation button prompts option. By popular demand!
[*]We went into George Lucas mode and made minor changes to 10 clips to smooth out some remaining editing issues.
[*][b]Global Stats detailed breakdowns:[/b]

[*]The Soundtrack DLC has been updated to Steam’s new Soundtrack format.
[*]New images added to fully support Steam’s new Library view. Our Library page is all spiffy looking now!
[/list]

notes.title: 2022 Patch 1
notes.notes:
A [i]Press X to Not Die[/i] update in 2022? It’s true!

We’re working on [i]cough[/i] something new [i]cough[/i] and taking the opportunity to port some of the new features we're developing back into [i]Press X to Not Die[/i]. This patch is happening now cause we wanted to get recording Global Stats out ASAP, with cooler stuff coming later on.

In this patch:
[list]
[*]As part of modernizing our dev tools, we’ve migrated the game engine from an FNA/XNA hybrid to an FNA/MonoGame hybrid. This fundamentally changes how the game handles all text and art assets so please let us know if you notice anything amiss!
[*]Global Stats: We never got these working consistently before but now they are. Ever wanted to know just how many times people have died or tried to watch Christina shower? Well, unfortunately, we were only able to record those numbers about 9% of the time before but we’ll be recording them 100% of the time from now on!
[*]Mouse makes more sense now. Ever click on one menu item and then the game opened a different menu item instead? Yeah, the old mouse code was weird and just kind of simulated a gamepad controlling the menus. Now it actually functions like how you’d expect a mouse to work!
[*]1994 Mode: Now pixelates absolutely everything, including pop-ups.
[*]Other bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Stats Tracking Update
notes.notes:
New update out today adds stat tracking so you can know how much of the game you've experienced!

Did you know that in a typical playthrough you might see less than half of Press X to Not Die? Now you can know with the new progress stat that tracks how much of the game you've seen. It'll show up on the end game screen, in your achievements, and on the new Stats screen under "Stats & Leaderboards".

Along the same lines, there's also a new stat and achievement for how many of the different deaths you've experienced. You haven't lived until you've died 23 different ways!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/402330/
